_status: HARVEST DRAFT — not applied. Candidate row for experience_patterns (P2).
_harvested: 2026-07-26 from the live vonc.com feed-driven CTAs — provocation-card (today.primary_cta / secondary_cta) and lobby-grid (arena.cards[].url). Two different components, one clause: harvested because that repetition is the register's whole claim.
name: feed-promised-cta
display_name: A call to action whose label and destination come from the same record
description: The label a visitor reads and the place the control takes them are one fact, carried together in one record, and the destination must resolve to a live page whose role matches what the label promises.

contract.outcome: a real page load of the destination named in the same record as the label; the destination page is live and of the promised role, and it delivers what the label said it would
must_not: be rendered at all when the record has no destination
contract.why: a component that declares a button's label and its URL as two unrelated schema fields, with nothing expressing that a label implies a destination, is bugs_open/023's root cause stated exactly. Binding label and destination in one record is the smallest structural answer.
contract.evidence: provocations.json today.primary_cta{label,url} + secondary_cta{label,url}; arena.cards[]{title,url}; EXPERIENCE_PLAN 'vonc-spark-game' §2 promise ledger, which states the same rule per CTA in prose

_SCHEMA_DELTA: data_contract / degraded_states are fields the draft DDL does not have — see HARVEST_01 §3.

data_contract.absence_semantics: a record with a label but no destination MUST NOT render a control — the CTA is omitted, never pointed at '#'
data_contract.prohibition: no number rendered beside a CTA unless it is true by construction (vonc: '20:00 on the clock', '3 objectives', '1 verdict' replaced a fabricated participation count)

degraded_states.outcome: the built HTML's own CTA content stands (build-time content is not overwritten by a failed fetch); no empty button appears

checks._unsupported: no attribute assertion exists; today this is only reachable through the separate dead-control sweep, after the page is built (HARVEST_01 §3.2)
page_status_ok has no url parameter — it asserts the page under test only, so 'the promise is kept' cannot be checked from the promising page (HARVEST_01 §3.3)
